name: Spiritual Gifts
overview: Scripture teaches that spiritual gifts are graciously distributed by God according to His sovereign measure of faith within each believer, calling for humility and sober self-assessment (Romans 12:3, 6). These gifts, which include roles such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers, are given to equip the church for ministry and to build up the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11). Believers receive power through the Holy Spirit to be effective witnesses for Christ, extending from local to global mission (Acts 1:8).
